phase:21: Separate on_error dispatch, typed error-slot identity/value/taint, then/successor forward transitions and handler outcome propagation. Reuse vb-ekkau and scoped compiler/recovery work where applicable.

Closure must distinguish handled versus unhandled failure, correct handler/continuation selection and exact error-slot/routing state, including relevant invalid-handler/transition boundaries; preserve separate primitive-family ownership rather than using one broad recovery suite as all-phase proof.
